value.rationale: The recent source explicitly raises whether the ordinal-pattern transition walk preserves source invariants beyond one-step accuracy. Exact TV divergence exponent and relative-entropy rate quantify a fundamental dynamical-fidelity limitation, despite exact short-range training and a positive Markov spectral gap, on every irrational rate in a natural one-parameter family. This is more than a generic finite-statistics-is-not-all-statistics observation and is relevant to interpreting proxy statistics; it does not criticize reservoir usefulness.
